### Highest and Best Knowledge (Truth for Life - August 4, 2011)
Author: Alistair Begg (Truth for Life)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-4-2011.html
Passage: Daniel 11:32
Points:
- Spiritual knowledge of God is the highest knowledge and the true source of inner strength for believers.
- Knowing Christ deepens our love for Him, because we cannot deeply love a Savior we barely know.
- True knowledge clears away ignorance and strengthens our hope in the glory yet to be revealed.
- Understanding Christ's sympathy and the purpose behind God's discipline provides patience in trials.
- Continual growth in the knowledge of Jesus is vital for spiritual development and perseverance.
